meta.title: Config sync
meta.description: Upload this machine's configuration to the cloud in one click, sync it back, and see at a glance whether the two agree.

title: Config sync
subtitle: Send this machine's configuration to the cloud, or bring the cloud copy back here.
pluginsHint: A backup never carries plugin packages. After a sync, what is still missing is listed here and can be installed in one action.
newMachineTitle: Using this on another computer the first time
newMachineStep1: Install this plugin there, then restart DSH.
newMachineStep2: Give it a token for the same GitHub account: a secret Gist is readable through the API only by its owner.
newMachineStep3: Open this page and sync the cloud copy down.
newMachineStep4: What is still missing then appears here; install it in one action, then restart DSH.
tokenHelp: The three token sources and the gist scope are in the error message.
